name: Compact Modern (Calibri)
description: A dense, technology-focused full-stack resume with a graphic name banner, heading-styled section titles and long bulleted achievement lists under each role.
style_summary: Very content-dense single-column layout that leads with a drawing/text-box name banner and compact contact details, then packs skills into slash-separated technology lines. Each job uses a three-line header (role + dates, company + location, then an italic 'Technical Scope' technology list) followed by a long run of achievement bullets with bolded metrics. Typography mixes Arial Black and Calibri Light at small sizes (10.5-12pt) for a modern engineering feel, with minimal white space and occasional project URLs. Best suited to senior software engineers who need to display broad tech stacks and quantified impact.
best_for: Roles that value many concrete achievements
